data.name: After the Bite
data.detailed_description:
After the Bite is a music-driven gothic visual novel with passive progression where each scene advances the story through lyrics, animation, and choice.

Animated characters, environments, and visualizers shape each scene. When each song ends, your choices decide where to explore next.

Follow branching paths through a sealed house where comfort, distraction, and revelation compete for your attention.

Four Voices Guide the Night

Four presences guide your path through the house. Each has a distinct personality, visual style, and musical identity shaped by classical motifs. Together, they lead you through a story of two bites, both ending in death.

The Internet: Toccata and Fugue
Attention, obsession, and endless connection.

The Cat: Hall of the Mountain King
Curiosity, temptation, and indulgence.

The Moon: Moonlight Sonata
Comfort, reflection, and quiet surrender.

The Forbidden
Sees what you really are.

Animated Atmosphere

Mist drifts through the halls. Screens glow like stained glass. Characters shift, gesture, and perform within each scene while subtle motion runs through every room. The house is never completely still.

Progress Through the Night

Between songs, you choose where to go next. Move through the house, uncover new scenes, and unlock paths that lead deeper into the night.

Idle progression continues as you explore, with listening opening the way to new discoveries. Spend what you earn on upgrades that shape how quickly you grow, what you uncover, and which routes open to you.

From the house to the garden beyond, each space offers a different way forward.

Gameplay Summary

  • Follow a music-driven narrative told through lyrics, animation, and choice

  • Encounter four distinct characters with their own musical identity

  • Unlock branching paths through a map woven across the house

  • Make progress between songs as you explore and uncover new paths

  • Expand your options through skill tree upgrades

  • Tend the dark garden beyond the house

  • Experience a night crafted for a 2–3 hour playthrough

data.short_description: In a house that won’t let you leave, a shadowed story unfolds through music, animation, choice, and passive progression. Follow branching paths between songs and uncover new scenes in a music-driven visual novel.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes including psychological horror, stylized blood, references to violence, sexual innuendo, and references to illegal drug use. Some scenes and lyrics may be unsettling to sensitive players. No explicit sexual acts or graphic gore are depicted.
